allow: command(Get-Process chrome -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, MainWindowTitle)
command(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, MainWindowTitle)
command(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'chrome.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -notmatch "--type=" } | Select-Object ProcessId, CommandLine)
command(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, MainWindowTitle, MainWindowHandle)
command(Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Google\Chrome Dev\User Data" -Recurse -Filter "*Session*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName, Length, LastWriteTime)
command(Get-Item "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Google\Chrome Dev\User Data\Default\Sessions\*" | Select-Object Name, Length, LastWriteTime)

command($stream = [System.IO.File]::Open("$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Google\Chrome Dev\User Data\Default\Sessions\Session_13435610936154100", [System.IO.FileMode]::Open, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Read, [System.IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite)
$reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream)
$content = $reader.ReadToEnd()
$reader.Close()
$stream.Close()
[regex]::Matches($content, 'https?://[^\x00-\x1f\x7f-\xff"''<> ]+') | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Select-Object -Unique)

command($share = [System.IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite -bor [System.IO.FileShare]::Delete
$stream = [System.IO.FileStream]::new("$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Google\Chrome Dev\User Data\Default\Sessions\Tabs_13435610627975906", [System.IO.FileMode]::Open, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Read, $share)
$reader = [System.IO.StreamReader]::new($stream)
$content = $reader.ReadToEnd()
$reader.Close()
$stream.Close()
"Tabs file read successfully, length: " + $content.Length)
